Name: KMF Blackmarket (CP)
Author: keithmfrench
Description:
My take on a Blackmarket mod.
Adds a Joja employee to the tunnel after you complete the community center, this allows you to buy Joja exclusives and other late game items.
[b]Shop will not appear if you do the Joja route.
[/b]
Prices are high, but it's only money.

Current Items Include:
--------------------
Always Available:
﻿Joja Cola
﻿Auto Petter
﻿Joja Catalogue
﻿ ﻿IF [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] is installed:
﻿Joja Veggie Seeds
﻿Joja Berry Starter
﻿Razor Trout
       Super Joja Cola

Randomly Available Each Day: (it is random so you may get none)
﻿Prismatic Shard
﻿Galaxy Soul
﻿Iridium Sprinklers
﻿Pressure Nozzle
﻿Rare Seeds
﻿Magic Bait
﻿Golden Egg (for those that don't want to get perfection)
--------------------

If you have any other ideas of what should be sold let me know.
I may make the employee a NPC at some point, but that would require a lot more work. Plus involve moving him out of the tunnel, so for now he is just a tile entity.

--------------------

Credit for this idea comes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8804]Joja Blackmarket[/url]﻿ by Coppersun. It sold many of their own mod items. This one does not sell that stuff.
However, If they feels my mod is too similar and want me to take it down I will.
that mod required STF which is not used anymore. which is why i remade it from scratch.

I rewrote it to require only [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

The sprites are all from the base game files as I can't do sprites well.

Thanks to everyone on the "stardew discord - mod making general" for helping me figure out how to make this.
